map.客户获取成本CAC计算器 使用指南: CAC customer acquisition cost calculator guide
map.计算客户获取成本（Customer Acquisition Cost），衡量获取: Compute the Customer Acquisition Cost, measuring the total spend to acquire one new customer
map.把营销费+销售费摊到新增客户，算真实获客成本。: Spread marketing plus sales spend over new customers to get the true acquisition cost.
map.结合 LTV 看 CAC 是否健康（LTV:CAC≥3 为佳）。: Read CAC together with LTV to judge health (LTV:CAC >= 3 is good).
map.拆分营销端/销售端 CAC 找费用大头。: Split CAC into marketing and sales sides to find the biggest cost item.
map.：营销费 8000、销售费 2000、新增客户 200 → CAC=(8000+: : marketing spend 8,000, sales spend 2,000, 200 new customers -> CAC = (8000 + 2000)/200 = 50 CNY; marketing-side CAC = 40, sales-side CAC = 10. With LTV = 3000 the LTV:CAC is 60, excellent.
map.：CAC=50、LTV=3000（按 36 个月摊）→ 月回收=3000/36≈: : CAC = 50, LTV = 3000 (spread over 36 months) -> monthly recovery = 3000/36, about 83 CNY, payback = 50/83, about 0.6 months, an extremely fast recovery.
map.建议含。只算广告费会低估真实获客成本，尤其高客单价靠销售跟进的业务。: Include them. Counting only ad spend understates the true acquisition cost, especially for high-ticket businesses that rely on sales follow-up.
map.看客单价与 LTV，通用经验 CAC<100 优秀、100–500 良好、>20: Look at order value and LTV; the common rule of thumb is CAC below 100 excellent, 100-500 good, above 2000 high, and only complete when read with LTV:CAC.
